SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch No. 62 39
REPORT
SHA... File No. CRT 7935
Date December 27, 1939.

Subject Shanghai Municipality Public Latrine Toilet Paper Sellers' Union -
meeting re the dissatisfaction by sellers in the Settlement Public
Latrines.
Made by D.S.I. Hide, Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

Between 2.30 p.m. and 4.30 p.m. on December 26,
1939, the Shanghai Municipality Public Latrine Toilet
Paper Sellers' Union held a meeting in the Offices
of the Bureau of Social Affairs, North Soochow Road,
to discuss appropriate measures against the Tung Faung
(東方) Company which has secured the contract for
the sale of toilet paper in the P.W.D. public latrines
for the year 1940. One Lieu Kuo Kia (劉國階) acted
as chairman of the meeting which was attended by some
30 members. Dih Chi Min (翟啟明), representative of
the Chinese Labourers' Welfare Association and member
of the Standing Committee of the Ordure Coolies' Union,
and Zung Chun roh (陳君樸), representative of the
Third Section of the Great People Society, were also
present. The following resolutions were passed.
(1) That a petition be submitted to the S.M.C. requesting
them to check the increase of contract fees.
(2) That no sub-contract be made with the head contractor.
(3) That resistance to the end be observed.
(4) That the Union carry out all negotiations and
that regulations be obeyed.
(5) That a union for the unemployed be organized.
(6) The following members were elected to serve on the
Executive Committee:-
Lieu Kuo Kia (刘國階) - Avenue Haig Latrine.
Tsang Ah Kung (張阿根) - Taku Road Latrine.
Zee Ching Kee (徐錦記) - Moulmein Road Latrine.
Ryi Ah Ming (李阿明) - Shanhaikwan Road

日期：1939年12月27日。

主题：上海市公共厕所卫生纸卖方工会——
关于租界公共厕所卖方不满情绪的会议。
由副督察海德（Hide）撰写，由督察克劳福德（Crawford）转发。

1939年12月26日下午2时30分至4时30分，上海市公共厕所卫生纸卖方工会在北苏州路社会局办公室举行会议，讨论针对东方（Tung Faung）公司采取适当措施，该公司已获得1940年度工务局公共厕所卫生纸销售合同。刘国阶（Lieu Kuo Kia）担任会议主席，约有30名成员出席。中国劳工福利协会代表、粪夫工会常务委员会委员翟启明（Dih Chi Min），以及大同社第三分部代表陈君樸（Zung Chun roh）也出席了会议。通过以下决议：
(1) 向工部局提交请愿书，要求其核查合同费用的增加。
(2) 不与总承包商签订分包合同。
(3) 坚持抵抗到底。
(4) 由工会进行所有谈判，并遵守规章。
(5) 组织失业者工会。
(6) 选举以下成员担任执行委员会职务：-
刘国阶（Lieu Kuo Kia） - 海格路（Avenue Haig）厕所。
张阿根（Tsang Ah Kung） - 大沽路（Taku Road）厕所。
徐锦记（Zee Ching Kee） - 莫尔尼路（Moulmein Road）厕所。
李阿明（Ryi Ah Ming） - 山海关路（Shanhaikwan Road）

Zung Yih Ling (陳延林), Park Road Latrine,
residing at 70 Yung Chi Li (永吉里),

Translation of a petition submitted by the
Public Latrine Toilet Paper Sellers in the
Settlement to the Commissioner of P.W.D.,
S.M.C. on December 12, 1939.

Commissioner of P.W.D.,

We hereby beg to state that on December 4, 1939, we
were informed by your honour of the impending tender and on the
following day (5th) the tender was given to the winner who
quoted $15,180.00 being announced. In view of the huge amount
quoted and the high cost of the toilet paper, we are unable
to carry on. We then requested the Commissioner to grant us
the contract for coming year to which you promised to consider
and let us know the result on Decembe , but on the date
promised we were instructed to wait till December 11 and on
the latter date we were again told to wait. We are extremely
anxious over the unsettled problem. Apart from the above,
the new contractor has despatched his representatives who
were employees of the Tung Fang Company which held the contract
in 1937 to various lavatories demanding increases in respect
of the sale of toilet paper ranging from 70% to 100% on the
original contract which otherwise will be cancelled.

In the past 10 years there has been no contractor so
experienced and thoughtless to his sub-contractors. We are
at a loss to know what to do and therefore we again beg to
request your early decision awarding the contract to us or to
someone well experienced in the trade.

Should the alleged contractor succeed to take up the
contract, we approximately 100 in all will starve.

Public Latrine Toilet Paper Sellers.
page_data.zh:
1939年12月12日租界公共厕所卫生纸卖方向
上海公共租界工部局工务处处长提交的
请愿书译文。

工务处处长，

我们谨此陈述，1939年12月4日，我们获悉阁下关于即将进行的招标的通知，次日（5日）宣布中标者报价为15,180.00美元。鉴于报价金额巨大且卫生纸成本高昂，我们无法继续经营。随后我们请求处长将下一年度的合同授予我们，您承诺予以考虑并于12月告知结果，但在承诺之日，我们被告知等待至12月11日，而在该日我们又被告知继续等待。我们对这一悬而未决的问题感到极度焦虑。除此之外，新承包商已派遣其代表（即1937年持有合同的东方公司员工）前往各公厕，要求在原合同基础上将卫生纸销售费用提高70%至100%，否则将取消合同。

在过去10年中，从未有过如此经验丰富却对分包商如此不顾及的承包商。我们不知所措，因此再次恳请阁下尽早作出决定，将合同授予我们或行业内经验丰富的人士。

如果所谓的承包商成功获得合同，我们大约100人将面临饥饿。

公共厕所卫生纸卖方。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :- 27.12.39(AM)
PUBLIC LAVATORY TOILET PAPER SELLERS HOLD MEETING
At 2 p.m. December 26 the Preparatory
Committee of the International Settlement Public Lavatory
Toilet Paper Sellers' Union held a meeting at the
auditorium of the former Chinese Chamber of Commerce on
North Honan Road. More than 100 persons, including
representatives of the Great People's Association and
the Chinese-Workers' Welfare Association, attended.
The following resolutions were passed:-
(1) That Lieu Kuo-chia (刘国阶), Chang ..h-
keng (张鸿根) and five others be appointed members of
the Preparatory Committee.
(2) That an appeal be made to the S.M.C.
(3) That various sub-contractors be asked to
refrain from undertaking leases from the main contractors.
(4) That all members observe the regulations of
the Union and remain calm so as to facilitate the work of
the Union in dealing with the situation.
(5) That the workers organize an Unemployed
Group.

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：1939年12月27日（上午版）
公共厕所卫生纸卖方举行会议
12月26日下午2时，公共租界公共厕所卫生纸卖方工会筹备委员会在北河南路原中国商会礼堂举行会议。包括大同社和中国劳工福利协会代表在内的100多人出席。通过以下决议：-
(1) 任命刘国阶、张鸿根（Chang ..h-keng，原文不清，推测为张鸿根）等五人为筹备委员会委员。
(2) 向工部局提出呼吁。
(3) 要求各分包商不要从主承包商处承租。
(4) 所有成员遵守工会规章并保持冷静，以便工会处理局势的工作顺利进行。
(5) 工人组织失业小组。

Translation of Petition handed
in in the afternoon of 18.12.39

Being in possession of considerable money and
not understanding our difficulties under the present
situation, the new contractor secured the contract for
the sale of toilet paper in the P.W.D. public latrines
for the year 1940 by offering a sum which exceeds by more
than 100% of the 1939 contract to the Council, thus
depriving us of our livelihood and rendering us liable to
starve.

After obtaining the contract, the contractor on
December 15, 1939 inserted an advertisement in the local
newspaper calling for new toilet paper sellers in the
public latrines instead of informing us regarding the
renewal of our contracts. It is evidently his intention
to oust us despite the fact that we have been so employed
for the past ten years or thereabouts. In brief what the
new contractor has done is inhuman.

We are greatly surprised to learn that the contract
has been awarded to the Tung Faung (Eastern) Company which
in noway appeared during the opening of the tenders. We
hope the S.M.C. has not employed inadequate procedure and
should like to know where and how the company came into
contact. Furthermore the P.W.D. have all the time ignored
our heart-felt requests to award the contract directly to
us in view of which the P.W.D. authorities have actually
neglected the citizens of the city.

Each of us is supporting a family of several members
therefore a total number of persons not less thousand are
depending upon us. Should we be deprived of our means of
livelihood, a thousand persons will become homeless and
starve. Besides, we cannot return to our native homes as
they are occupied by the Japanese Army. Being thus placed
we are compelled to run risks. Have pity on us. We
respectfully beg your efficient and impartial investigation
in order to

1939年12月18日下午提交的请愿书译文

新承包商拥有大量资金，且不理解我们在当前局势下的困难，通过向公董局提供超过1939年合同金额100%以上的款项，获得了1940年度工务局公共厕所卫生纸销售合同，从而剥夺了我们的生计，使我们面临饥饿的危险。

获得合同后，承包商于1939年12月15日在当地报纸上刊登广告，招募新的公共厕所卫生纸卖方，而不是通知我们续签合同。这显然表明他意图驱逐我们，尽管我们已被雇佣约十年之久。简而言之，新承包商的行为是不人道的。

我们惊讶地获悉，合同被授予了在开标过程中从未露面的东方（Tung Faung）公司。我们希望工部局没有采用不当程序，并想了解该公司是在何处以及如何接触的。此外，工务局一直无视我们将合同直接授予我们的衷心请求，鉴于此，工务局当局实际上忽视了本市市民。

我们每个人都要供养一个数口之家，因此依赖我们生活的人数不少于一千人。如果我们被剥夺生计，一千人将无家可归并挨饿。此外，我们无法返回家乡，因为家乡已被日军占领。处于此种境地，我们被迫冒险。请怜悯我们。我们恭敬地请求阁下进行高效且公正的调查，以便

March 29, 1928.    19

The Commissioner of Police.

PUBLIC LATRINES.

With reference to the Commissioner's letter dated
December 28th, 1927, I beg to inform you that a contract has
been let to Sung Chang Sung for a period of 12 months commenc-
ing from the 1st proximo for the sale of toilet paper at all
of the Council's latrines.

The stipulations are that the price to be charged
shall not exceed one copper per sheet and that the purchase
shall be entirely voluntary, no attempt to be made by the
Contractor's coolies to force the sale of the paper. I regard
this latter stipulation as of great importance, as otherwise
an impression might be made that the Council was charging an
entrance fee.

J.S. Reedman
Deputy Commissioner of Public Works.

page_data.en:
Free translation of note received from Sung Sung Yung to the
Public Health Department, Shanghai Municipal Council.

The writer states that the coolie who sells
toilet paper at the public latrine under the Henan Road
Bridge insists on persons buying paper when they enter the
latrine. If persons do not buy the paper from him he
prevents them from using the latrine. As the Council's
regulations states that the purchase of paper is not obligatory
the Council is requested to investigate.
page_data.zh:
宋松荣（Sung Sung Yung）致上海工部局卫生处的便条的自由译文。

写信人称，在河南路桥下的公共厕所销售厕纸的苦力坚持要求进入厕所的人购买厕纸。如果人们不向他购买厕纸，他就阻止他们使用厕所。鉴于工部局规章规定购买厕纸并非强制义务，故请求工部局进行调查。

page_data.en:
Precis translation of a letter from Mr Yuan of Tangshan
Road and Kwenming Road, dated today.
(30/12/34)

Sir,

There are persons using the name "Shanghai Municipal
Council", who stand at the entrance of the public lavator-
ies in lane 977 East Seward Road connecting with lane 510
Tangshan Road and in the lanes in Hongkew, and charge
one copper for toilet paper to each person using the w.c.
If anyone cannot pay a copper, then the person selling
the toilet paper curses him and pulls him out without
letting him use the w.c. Quarrels and fights take place,
and there are no constables within call. The Police
Station say it is only a matter of a copper and take no
action.

I beg you to instruct all police stations to
control this matter. Notices posted up at the entrances
of the public lavatories state free of charge, and no
forcible sale of toilet paper. It is quite clear that
the S.M.C. did not appoint these persons to sell toilet
paper.

AC
21/
page_data.zh:
唐山路与昆明路袁先生今日来信的精确译文。
(34/12/30)

先生，

有一些人冒用“上海工部局”之名，站在东熙华德路977弄与唐山路510弄相连处的公共厕所入口，以及虹口的各弄堂内，向每位使用厕所的人收取一枚铜元的厕纸费。如果有人付不出一枚铜元，卖厕纸的人就会咒骂他，并将他拉出来，不让他使用厕所。由此引发争吵和斗殴，而附近没有巡捕。警察分局称这不过是一枚铜元的小事，不予处理。

恳请阁下指令所有警察分局管控此事。张贴在公共厕所入口的告示写明免费，且不得强行销售厕纸。很明显，上海工部局并未任命这些人销售厕纸。

AC
21/

File No. ............

REPORT
Wayside Station,
Date December 28th 1934.
No. 9279 H' GISTRY
Dat 31/ 12/ 34

Subject (in full)........................................Attached.

Made by....................and........................Forwarded by Chief Inspector Ginnane.

Sir,

Re attached, I beg to report that a Chinese named Chang
Boo Zung (張步昌), 44 Tongshan Road is the S. M. C. ( P. W. D. )
Contractor for the sale of toilet paper at the various Public
( Chinese ) Latrines in the Settlement. For this exclusive
privilege he pays a monthly sum of $2,720.00 to the S. M. C.
Mr. Chang sub-lets the Contract to various sub-contractors who
provide their own toilet paper and for the privilege of selling
same at the various latrines pay Mr. Chang a monthly sum according
to the locality. For instance Broadway & Wayside pays $90.00,
Lane 977 East Seward Road pays $75.00 and East Yuhang Road and
Dent Road pays $25.00. Undoubtedly the coolies selling the
toilet paper endeavour to sell as much as possible in order to
make a profit. On the 27-12-34 I instructed a Sub-Inspector to
take out a Station coolie and send him into a few latrines without
purchasing toilet paper, the toilet paper coolie promptly prevent-
ed the Station coolie from entering any of the latrines visited
without first purchasing toilet paper.

Condition 2 of Mr. Chang's Contract reads as follows:-
" The Contractor's employees shall not conduct the sale
of paper from inside any latrine, but may station them-
selves at the entrances, nor shall they attempt to
prevent voluntary free use of the latrines irrespective
of the purchase of paper. Violation of either of these
conditions shall render the Contractor liable to a fine
not exceeding S. S. $10.00 for every of such offence
and repeated violations of either of these conditions
shall, at the discretion of the Council, lead to can-
cellation of the contract. "

日期 34/ 12/ 31

主题（全称）........................................附件。

由....................制作并由........................总督察 Ginnane 转发。

先生，

关于附件，谨此报告，一名叫张步昌（Chang Boo Zung）的华人，住址为唐山路44号，是上海工部局（工务处）在租界内各公共（华人）厕所销售厕纸的承包商。为此独家特权，他每月向上海工部局支付2,720.00美元。张先生将合同转租给各个分包商，分包商自行提供厕纸，并根据地段不同，每月向张先生支付一定金额以获得在各厕所销售的 privilege。例如，百老汇路及路边巡捕房辖区支付90.00美元，东熙华德路977弄支付75.00美元，东余杭路和丹徒路支付25.00美元。毫无疑问，销售厕纸的苦力为了获利，会尽力多卖。在1934年12月27日，我指示一名副督察带出一名巡捕房苦力，让他在不购买厕纸的情况下进入几个厕所，结果卖厕纸的苦力立即阻止该巡捕房苦力进入任何 visited 的厕所，除非先购买厕纸。

张先生合同的第2条规定如下：
“承包商的雇员不得在任何厕所内部进行纸张销售，但可 stationed 在入口处，也不得试图阻止人们自愿免费使用厕所，无论其是否购买纸张。违反其中任何一条款，承包商每次违规将被处以不超过小洋10.00元的罚款，若屡次违反其中任何一条款，工部局可自行决定取消合同。”

Subject Complaint by Chang Foh-liu, ex-sub-contractor for the sale of toilet paper at public lavatories
Made by D. S. McKeown Forwarded by （签名）

The Tung Fang Company (東方公司), Contractor for the sale of toilet paper at public lavatories in the Settlement for 1937, received on 24/6/37 a letter from a lawyer named Wang Kien-ngoh (王劍) with an office at no.8 King Sien Villa, Myburgh Road, acting on behalf of Chang Foh-liu (張福履), the ex-sub-contractor for the sale of toilet paper at the Baikal and Kwenming Roads lavatories. This letter (translation attached) denounces the Tung Fang Company for having cancelled Chang Foh Liu's contract and accuses C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang of having abused his authority in intervening in the dispute which is of a private nature.

Chang Foh-liu, who was the principal instigator of the recent agitation among sub-contractors for a reduction in contract fees and the removal of the S.M.C. guard, stating that the purchase of toilet paper was not compulsory, from public lavatories, was arrested on May 21 for intimidating a representative of the contractor, detained in custody for 13 days and finally sentenced to a fine of $20 or 20 days' detention by the 1st Special District Court on June 3.

In compliance with the instructions of the D.C. (Special Branch), Chang Foh-liu was summoned to the Police Headquarters on the morning of June 15 and warned by C.D.I. Ross, P.A. to D.C. (Special Branch), in the presence of C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang and D.S. McKeown against further intimidating the employees of the contractor, the Tung Fang Company, who would take over the sale of toilet paper at the two lavatories in question with effect from the afternoon of June 15. Chang was also advised to take civil action against the contractor if he so desired, but warned that no further unlawful activities would

日期 1937年6月25日。

事由 前公共厕所卫生纸销售分包商张福履（Chang Foh-liu）之投诉
由 D. S. McKeown 呈报 转呈 （签名）

东方公司（Tung Fang Company），即1937年度租界内公共厕所卫生纸销售承包商，于1937年6月24日收到一名名为王剑（Wang Kien-ngoh，音译）的律师来信，该律师办公地址位于迈尔赫路（Myburgh Road）金仙别墅8号，代表贝加尔路（Baikal Road）和昆明路（Kwenming Road）厕所卫生纸销售的前分包商张福履（Chang Foh-liu）。此信（附译文）谴责东方公司取消了张福履的合同，并指控特务科警探西子良（Sih Tse-liang，音译）滥用职权干预这一纯属私人性质的纠纷。

张福履是近期分包商要求降低承包费并移除公共厕所内“购买卫生纸非强制”告示牌骚乱的主要煽动者，他于5月21日因恐吓承包商代表而被捕，被拘留13天，最终于6月3日被第一特区法院判处罚款20元或监禁20天。

遵照特务科副主管（D.C. (Special Branch)）的指示，张福履于6月15日上午被传唤至警察总局，在特务科警探西子良和 D.S. McKeown 在场的情况下，由特务科副主管助理罗斯（Ross）警探对其提出警告，不得再恐吓东方公司（即将于6月15日下午接管上述两所厕所卫生纸销售业务）的员工。同时也建议张福履如有意愿可对该承包商提起民事诉讼，但警告称不再容忍任何进一步的非法活动

June 23, 1937.

Chang Foh Liu (张福麟), my client, came to my
office and made the following statement :-
"In connection with the refusal of the Tung
Fang Shing Chi Company to receive payment for my contract
for the sale of toilet paper at public lavatories, I asked
you on the 1st instant to send a letter on my behalf to
the Company
"At 11 a.m. on the 15th instant, a man named Sih
Tse-liang who claimed to be a detective inspector of the
Special Branch of the Central Police Station, after listen-
ing to what was told by Chang Dong Shing, attempted to
force me to release the contract for the sale of toilet
paper at a public lavatory on Kwenming Road and at another
one on Baikal Road for both of which I have been sub-
contractor for a period of eight or nine years. He threatened
that unless I complied with this, he would arrest me.
"At the same time, at the instigation of Chang
Dong Shing, Chiang Ah Dah, Ching Chang Sung, Woo Ah Nyi,
Zao Siao-pei-ts and Zi Chao Zao, accompanied by a party
of police, took possession of the two lavatories by force.
Six days have elapsed since the incident.
"Contracting for the sale of toilet paper at public
lavatories is a bona fide business. Both the lessor and
the lessee must abide by the usual contract system and
adhere to the terms of the agreement concluded by the two
parties. If either of the two parties wishes to withdraw
from the agreement, he must furnish substantial reasons
to support his action. In the event of the other party

1937年6月23日。

我的当事人张福麟（Chang Foh Liu，音译）来到我的
办公室并作了如下陈述：-
“关于东方兴记公司（Tung Fang Shing Chi Company）拒绝接收我
就公共厕所卫生纸销售合同支付的款项一事，我曾于本月1日请
您代表我向该公司发函
“本月15日上午11时，一名自称是中央捕房特务科
警探的男子西子良（Sih Tse-liang，音译），在听取
张东生（Chang Dong Shing，音译）的陈述后，试图强
迫我放弃昆明路一处公共厕所及贝加尔路另一处公共厕
所的卫生纸销售合同，这两处我都已作为分包商经营了
八九年。他威胁说，除非我照办，否则就将逮捕我。
“与此同时，在张东生的唆使下，蒋阿大（Chiang Ah Dah，音译）、
程长松（Ching Chang Sung，音译）、吴阿二（Woo Ah Nyi，音译）、
赵小佩兹（Zao Siao-pei-ts，音译）及赵子朝（Zi Chao Zao，音译）等人，
在一队警察的陪同下，强行占用了这两所厕所。
距离事发已过去六天。
“承包公共厕所卫生纸销售是一项正当生意。出租方
和承租方都必须遵守通常的合同制度，并遵守双方达成
的协议条款。如果任何一方希望退出协议，必须提供充
分的理由来支持其行动。如果另一方

according to the legal procedure. No force can be employed

"The man, Sih Tse-liang, claims to be a detective

Translation of letter from Tung Fong Company. 7-6-37.

To S.M.C.

We beg to inform you that subsequent to our report
that the sub-contractors will form illegal unions thereby
refusing payment of contract price and enforcing the sale of
toilet paper, your Department has arrested the ring leader,
Tsang Foh-leu, and put the case to the criminal Court.
Although he was released, yet we are obliged to you for the
action thus taken. In View of Tsang's attempt to interfere
with our business we have decided to take over the business
ourselves in the Baikal and Kwenming Road Latrines. There-
fore two coolies were sent to these two places respectively
on June 1 to sell paper, but they were driven out by Tsang
on the evening of the 3rd at 7 o'clock who had a large
number of loafers with him. He declares that if Tung Fong
Company comes near the place again he will resort to drastic
action. Having heard that Tsang is a well known loafer in that
district and has a large number of followers we do not intend
to settle the matter by barbarous means which may easily
cause disorder in the Settlement. Yet if we leave this
matter un-reported it may encourage other latrine sub-contractors
to take similar action. We therefore shall be obliged if the
Council will again arrest this man and take such action as
you deem necessary in this matter so as to deter others. It will not only mean that our loss will be
mitigated to some extent, but also that confidence will
be placed in attempts of similar nature.

东方公司来信译文。 1937年6月7日。

致 上海公共租界工部局。

谨此告知，继我方报告分包商将组成非法工会，从而
拒绝支付合同价款并强制销售卫生纸之后，贵局已逮捕
了头目曾福履（Tsang Foh-leu，音译），并将此案提交刑
事法庭。虽然他已被释放，但我方仍对贵局采取的上述
行动表示感谢。鉴于曾氏企图干扰我方业务，我方决定
自行接管贝加尔路和昆明路厕所的业务。因此，我方于
6月1日分别派遣两名苦力前往这两处地点销售卫生纸，
但他们于3日晚7时被曾氏赶走，当时曾氏身边有大量
无业游民跟随。他宣称，如果东方公司再次靠近该地，
他将采取激烈行动。获悉曾氏是该地区知名的无业游民
且拥有众多追随者，我方不打算通过野蛮手段解决此事，
因为这很容易在租界内引起混乱。然而，如果我方对此
事不予报告，可能会鼓励其他厕所分包商采取类似行动。
因此，如蒙工部局再次逮捕此人，并采取贵局认为必要
的措施以儆效尤，我方将不胜感激。这不仅意味着我方
的损失将在一定程度上得到减轻，而且也将增强对类似
性质尝试的信心。

Date June 1. 1937.

Subject Public Lavatories in the Settlement.

Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

The case against the three sub-contractors for the
sale of toilet paper at public lavatories in the Settlement
came up for a second hearing at the 1st Special District Court
on May 29 when it was remanded to June 3 for judgment.
At 2 p.m. May 30, 1937, Mr. Chen Kiu-feng called at
the Tung Fong Company, Lane 568, 383 Sinza Road, which company
holds the contract for the sale of toilet paper in public
lavatories in the Settlement, and interviewed the manager of
the Company. During the interview, Mr. Chen Kiu-feng
explained that his object in approaching the management was
to secure co-operation between the contractor and the sub-
contractors in enforcing the demand for the removal of the
S.M.C. board installed at the entrance of the lavatories,
fixing the price of toilet paper, etc. In reply, the manager
replied that he had no intention of joining the movement and
only desired to observe the regulations of the S.M.C. and
the terms of contract. Subsequently Mr. Chen requested the
manager to permit Sub-contractors, Chang Foh-liu and Chang
Ah-kung (張福倫与張阿根), who were concerned in the case
of intimidation at Wayside, to retain their sub-contracts for
certain lavatories. In reply, the manager stated that he
had decided to withdraw the contracts from the two persons
concerned. After some persuasion, the manager agreed only
to withdraw the contract of Chang Foh-liu, whereupon Mr. Chen
Kiu-feng expressed his dissatisfaction, intimating that the
cancellation of the contract of one of the sub-contractors
would imply the withdrawal of the sub-contractors' money.

关于三名分包商在租界公共厕所销售卫生纸一案，于5月29日在第一特区地方法院进行第二次审讯，案件被押后至6月3日宣判。
1937年5月30日下午2时，陈九峰先生前往新闸路383号568弄东方公司，该公司持有在租界公共厕所销售卫生纸的合同，并会见了该公司经理。在会谈中，陈九峰先生解释称，他接触管理层的目的是为了确保承包商与分包商之间进行合作，以强制执行拆除安装在厕所入口处的工部局告示牌、固定卫生纸价格等要求。作为回应，经理回答说，他无意加入该运动，只希望遵守工部局的规章和合同条款。随后，陈先生请求经理允许涉及韦斯特路（Wayside）恐吓案的分包商张福伦与张阿根（Chang Foh-liu and Chang Ah-kung）保留某些厕所的分包合同。作为回应，经理表示他已决定收回这两人的合同。经过一番劝说，经理仅同意收回张福伦的合同，对此陈九峰先生表示不满，暗示取消其中一名分包商的合同意味着要退还分包商的钱款。

继三名租界公共厕所分包商因恐吓罪被捕后，5月22日下午3时，四名名为王文郎（Wong Wen-long）、楊文福（Yang Vung-foh）、劉永富（Liu Yung-foc）和曹連喜（Zau Lien-shi）的分包商前往北苏州路中国商会大楼的第一特区市民联合会，要求会见陈九峰先生（陳九峰）。当被告知陈先生不在办公地点时，来访者离去。

5月22日晚8时30分，这四名分包商在爱而近路8号351弄陈九峰先生家中拜访了他，当时他劝告他们不要失望，并继续他们的运动。分包商于晚8时40分离开该处。

据第一特区市民联合会秘书处称，陈九峰先生已代表分包商起草了一份请愿书（译文附本报告后），拟提交给第一特区市民联合会。收到请愿书后，市民联合会将指派陈先生协助分包商。随后将致函工部局和第一特区地方法院。

自三名分包商被捕以来，其他分包商包括王兴祿（Wong Shing-loh）、曹連喜（Zau Lien-shi）和楊文福（Yang Vung-foh）一直努力促成被捕人员获释。

It is learned that the sub-contractors are now

was anxious to advance his reputation by taking up the cause
of the sub-contractors, but his enthusiasm waned after the
court proceedings against the sub-contractors on May 22.
From full statement taken from the three accused in
custody (attached) no evidence can be brought forward to
prove that Mr. Chen Kiu-feng instigated acts of intimidation.
That meetings of sub-contractors were held on or about May 10
and May 19 in the home of Mr. Chen Kiu-feng is well established,
and there is no doubt that he was urging the sub-contractors
to the point where he would have an opportunity of again
making his presence felt in labour circles. The fact that
he instructed the sub-contractors not to pay the contractor
for this month while deposit the sum in the Municipal

The following is the statement of Chang Foh-liu (張福履 )
native of Kaoyui (高郵 ) taken by me D.S. McKeown
at Special Branch on the 24/5/37 and interpreted by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang

My name is Chang Foh-liu, native of Kaoyui, age 46,
staying at 223 Chusan Road. I am the sub-contractor for the
sale of toilet paper at the public lavatory on Kwenming Road
near Paoting Road, and the lavatory on Baikal Road near Dalny
Road for which privilege I have been accustomed to pay $26
per month to the contractor.

However since the Tung Fang Company (東方公司 )
obtained the contract for the sale of toilet paper at public
lavatories in the Settlement for this year, the monthly sum
paid to the S.M.C. by the contractor has been increased from
$2,725 to $3,853. Consequently, the Tung Fang Company increased
my fee from $26 to $69 a month. Owing to my objection, the
increased rate was reduced to $55, which I agreed to pay.
The first time, I went to the office of the Tung Fang Company,
which was then located in the Hung Ziang Lodging House, Avenue
Road, to pay my fee was on December 25, 1936, when the
proprietor of the Company was named Chang Dong-shing
(張同兴 ), and his agent Chiang Ah-doo (姜阿大 ) told me
that they would conduct negotiations with the S.M.C. for the
removal on March 1, 1937 of the boards which the Council had
fixed outside the public lavatories stating that the purchase
of toilet paper was not compulsory. Consequently I attended
my work quietly, until March 1, when I asked the proprietor
of the Tung Fang Company for information regarding the removal
of the boards, when I made my payment to him. He told me to
await quietly.

以下为本人 D.S. McKeown 于 1937 年 5 月 24 日在特别支部对高邮籍人士张福履（Chang Foh-liu）进行的讯问笔录，由 C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang 担任翻译：

我叫张福履，高邮人，现年 46 岁，居住在中山路 223 号。我是昆明路近保定路公共厕所及贝加尔路（Baikal Road）近大连路（Dalny Road）公共厕所手纸销售的转包商，为此特权我习惯每月向总承包商支付 26 美元。

然而，自从东方公司（Tung Fang Company）获得本年度租界内公共厕所手纸销售合同以来，总承包商向工部局（S.M.C.）支付的月费已从 2,725 美元增加至 3,853 美元。因此，东方公司将我的费用从每月 26 美元提高至 69 美元。由于我提出异议，涨价幅度被降至 55 美元，我同意支付此金额。我第一次去东方公司办公室缴费是在 1936 年 12 月 25 日，当时该公司位于爱文义路（Avenue Road）的洪祥旅馆（Hung Ziang Lodging House），公司老板名叫张同兴（Chang Dong-shing），其代理人姜阿大（Chiang Ah-doo）告诉我，他们将就移除工部局固定在公共厕所外、声明购买手纸非强制性的木板一事与工部局进行谈判，日期定为 1937 年 3 月 1 日。因此我安心工作，直到 3 月 1 日，我在向他付款时询问东方公司老板关于移除木板的情况。他让我静静等待。

My name is Yeu Doong-kyi, sub-contractor for the
sale of toilet paper at the public lavatory in an alleyway
on Tongshan Road near Kwenming Road. I am a native of
Kaoyu (高郵), age 49. I am residing at No.9 Miao Hou
Road, Shiang Yien Jao, Chapei.

Formerly I was a coolie in a Japanese cotton
ginning factory on Wuchow Road. I resigned owing to my
age. Through the recommendation of one named Liu Yung-ung
(劉永恩), a fellow countrymen and ordure cart coolie, who
is a "tutee" of Chiang Ah-doo (姜阿大), an agent of the
proprietor of the Tung Fang Company, I obtained the contract
for the sale of toilet paper at the above lavatory from
January 1, 1937, for which I was required to pay $72 a
month to the contractor. Prior to January 1, Chang Doong-
shing (張同興), the contractor, told me that the contract
fee for this year was higher than before, and consequently
the S.M.C. would be requested to have the boards fixed outside
the public lavatories, stating that the sale of toilet paper
was not compulsory, etc. removed by March 1, 1937.

About ten days ago (I cannot remember the date)
I met one Wong Vung-long (王文郎), also a sub-contractor,
on Wuchow Road, in the morning. He told me to go with him
to the home of Mr. Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峰), 8 Van Ziang Li,
Elgin Road, in order to request Mr. Chen to negotiate with
the S.M.C. for the removal of the boards. I went there with
him. On arrival, I saw some thirty sub-contractors assembled
in Chen's home. At about 10 a.m. Mr. Chen interviewed seven

我叫俞同义，是昆明路附近通山路一条弄堂内公共厕所手纸销售的转包商。我是高邮人，现年 49 岁。居住在闸北香尹桥（Shiang Yien Jao）庙后路 9 号。

以前我是梧州路一家日本轧花厂的苦力。因年龄原因辞职。通过同乡、粪车苦力刘永恩（Liu Yung-ung）的介绍——他是东方公司老板的代理人姜阿大（Chiang Ah-doo）的“门徒”——我获得了自 1937 年 1 月 1 日起上述厕所的手纸销售合同，为此我需每月向承包商支付 72 美元。在 1 月 1 日之前，承包商张同兴（Chang Doong-shing）告诉我，今年的合同费比以前高，因此将请求工部局在 1937 年 3 月 1 日前移除固定在公共厕所外、声明手纸销售非强制性等内容的木板。

大约十天前（我不记得具体日期），早上我在梧州路遇到了也是转包商的王文郎（Wong Vung-long）。他让我跟他一起去爱多亚路万祥里 8 号陈九峰先生（Mr. Chen Kiu-feng）家，请求陈先生与工部局交涉以移除木板。我随他前往。到达时，我看到陈家聚集了约三十名转包商。上午 10 点左右，陈先生接见了七

My name is Chang Ah-kung (張阿根). I am a native
of Kaoyu, age 45. I reside at No.1 Urga Road. I have been
the sub-contractor for the sale of toilet paper at the public
lavatory on Wuchow Road near Urga Road, the public lavatory
on Chaoufoong Road near Tungchow Road and the public lavatory
on Quinsan Road, since May, 1934. The total contract fee
was formerly $217, but it was increased to $230 from January
this year.

When I called to the office of the contractor, the
Tung Fang Company, in the Hung Ziang Hotel, Avenue Road,
in November, 1936, the contractor Chang Tung-shing (張同兴)
and his agent Chiang Ah-doo (姜阿大) told me that owing
to the fact that the contract fee paid to the S.M.C. had been
increased, my contract fee would also be increased. However,
he stated that the S.M.C. had introduced alterations in
the regulations regarding public lavatories, whereby the
boards fixed outside the lavatories stating that the sale
of toilet paper was not compulsory, etc. would be removed
by March 1, 1937. Consequently I did not oppose the increase
in the monthly fees.

Towards the end of April, we sub-contractors were
required by the contractor to provide guarantee bonds. We
all opposed this procedure, on the ground that we always
pay our fees in advance, and at the beginning of May about
10 sub-contractors, including myself, met in the Sing Shing
Teashop on Doong Chia Road, Chapei, when it was decided to
submit a petition to the 1st Special District Citizens'
page_data.zh:

以下为本人 D.G. McKeown 于 1937年5月25日在贝赛（Bayside）对高邮籍人士张阿根所作的供词记录，由书记员黄家清（Wong Chia-tsing，音译）翻译：

我叫张阿根（張阿根）。我是高邮人，现年45岁。我居住在乌尔嘎路（Urga Road）1号。自1934年5月以来，我一直担任以下公共厕所卫生纸销售的转包商：乌尔嘎路附近的梧州路公共厕所、通州路附近的昭丰路（Chaoufoong Road，音译）公共厕所，以及昆山路（Quinsan Road）公共厕所。总承包费原为217元，但从今年1月起增加至230元。

1936年11月，当我前往爱文义路（Avenue Road）洪祥旅馆内的总承包商“东方公司”办公室时，承包商张同兴（張同兴）及其代理人姜阿大（姜阿大，音译）告诉我，由于支付给工部局的承包费已增加，我的承包费也将随之增加。然而，他声称工部局已对有关公共厕所的规章进行了修改，规定固定在厕所外表明“购买卫生纸非强制”等内容的告示牌将于1937年3月1日前拆除。因此，我没有反对月费的增加。

4月底，总承包商要求我们转包商提供担保债券。我们都反对这一做法，理由是我们一直预缴费用。5月初，包括我在内的约10名转包商在闸北董家路（Doong Chia Road，音译）的新星茶楼（Sing Shing Teashop，音译）聚会，决定向第一特区市民联合会提交请愿书以求援助。该请愿书由租界内所有转包商签署，并于5月3日或4日由张福复（張福復）、杨文福（楊文福）、曹连喜（曹連喜）和陈有钰（陳有鈺）提交给联合会。后来，瑟卫路（Seward Road）附近天潼路（Tiendong Road）厕所的转包商杨文福来到我家，让我于5月5日前往埃尔金路（Elgin Road）万祥里8号陈秋峰（Chen Kiu-feng，音译）先生家中，听取关于向市民联合会请愿的答复。

请求他解释其中的内容。我于上午10点到达陈先生家，当时杨文福（楊文福）和其他约10人也在那里。上午11点，陈秋峰先生告诉我们，市民联合会已将我们的请愿书提交给工部局，并建议我们在等待答复期间安静等候。上午11点15分，我们离开。

5月18日，前公共厕所卫生纸销售转包商毛水梅（MAO Suen-mei，音译）来到我家，请我于5月19日前往陈秋峰先生家中询问答复情况。因此，5月19日上午，我前往陈先生家，在那里我看到了包括张福复和杨文福在内的其他约十人。这次，陈先生告诉我们，关于拆除告示牌的问题，我们仍需耐心等待答复。随后我们问他，我们是应该向承包商付款，还是将款项存入银行以待解决。陈先生回答说此事应由我们自己决定，于是我们散去。

此后，我不再参与纠纷，直到5月22日上午，余东其（Yeu Doong-kyi，音译）的妻子来找我，请我陪她去第一特区法院。我陪她到了法院，但我没有出庭受审，而是在走廊里等候，大约在上午11点20分被工部局警察逮捕。

（签名）张阿根。

Translation of a petition prepared by Mr. Chen KiuOfeng
on behalf of the sub-contractor, for presentation to the
1st Special District Citizens' Federation.
----------

We, the petitioners, are sub-contractors for
the sale of toilet paper at public lavatories in the
International Settlement. Owing to the high cost of
living and the increase of the contract fees, we are
about to lose money, we, therefore, held consultations
among ourselves and decided to request your Federation
to uphold justice and to write to the S.M.C. requesting
an alteration in the regulations governing the use of
lavatories by the public, or alternatively, an decrease
in the contract fees. Our activities in this connection
were resented by the S.M.C. and at 3 p.m. May 21 Chang
Foh-liu and Yu Doong-chien, two of our colleagues, were
arrested without cause by Wayside Police Station. They
were arraigned before the court on a charge of forming
a union and disturbing the peace of the community. We
aim at earning a living and have no intention of forming
a union. The fact that we have no union of our own
is borne out by our requesting your Federation to write
to the S.M.C.

The action of the Municipal Police in arresting
and charging the two sub-contractors is contrary to law
and sentiment. If our request could not be accepted,
the S.M.C. could send us a reply to this effect.

We were further surprised when we heard that on
the morning of May 22, another sub-contractor named Chang
□□□ (張阿根) was arrested at the court during the
hearing of the case against the first two sub-contractors.
As these arrests have alarmed the sub-contractors, we

我们请愿人是国际租界内公共厕所卫生纸销售的转包商。由于生活成本高企及承包费增加，我们将面临亏损，因此我们经过协商，决定请求贵联合会主持公道，致函工部局，要求修改管理公众使用厕所的规章，或者 alternatively（或者），降低承包费。我们在此方面的活动引起了工部局的不满，5月21日下午3点，我们的两位同事张福复和余东坚（Yu Doong-chien，音译）被路边巡捕房无故逮捕。他们以组织工会和扰乱社区安宁的罪名被提堂受审。我们旨在谋生，无意组织工会。我们请求贵联合会致函工部局这一事实，证明了我们并没有自己的工会。

9219/
24/ 5/ 37
Latrine Contractors
We have received the following joint letter from the
public latrine contractors :-
"We operate all Latrines for a period of 12
months. We sold coarse paper near the entrance of the latrines
at 1 cent to cover all the public and our facilities expenses.
This is strictly for cleanliness. This is first class
paper, and we sell it at cost price. The
public was satisfied with this arrangement and no complaints
were made. Recently, however, the price of paper has risen
and we are unable to continue selling it at 1 cent without
incurring a loss; therefore we are compelled to raise the
price to 2 cents; but even at this price we cannot make a profit
and will not be able to do so unless subject to an
extraordinary rise in the cost of paper, and this is an urgent necessity.
In order to give proper public notice in this respect and to
inform the public, we posted a notice on the door of each
latrine stating that 'this company has offered 86.00. We are now
forced to announce that to cover our expenses we shall charge
public latrines as follows:-
'Owing to the Council's unfavourable financial position,
the contract price has been increased. The sudden fall in
the value of coppers has caused considerable loss to the
paper sellers. The Council, fully aware of this fact,
recently considered the removal on 1st March from the various
public latrines of the notice:- 'This is a public latrine
for males. Not a cent is charged for admittance. One
copper, however, is charged for each sheet of coarse paper,
though the purchase of same is not compulsory.'
1.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 25 MAY 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

37年5月24日
厕所承包商
我们收到了来自公共厕所承包商的如下联名信：
“我们经营所有厕所以期12个月。我们在厕所入口处以1分钱的价格出售粗纸，以覆盖所有公共设施及我们的开支。这纯粹是为了清洁。这是一等纸，我们以成本价出售。公众对此安排表示满意，并无投诉。然而，最近纸张价格上涨，我们无法继续以1分钱的价格出售而不遭受损失；因此我们被迫将价格提高至2分钱；但即使在这个价格下，我们也无法获利，除非纸张成本出现异常上涨，否则我们将无法获利，而这是迫切需要的。
为了就此给予适当的公众通知并告知公众，我们在每个厕所门上张贴了告示， stating that 'this company has offered 86.00. We are now forced to announce that to cover our expenses we shall charge public latrines as follows:-（陈述‘本公司已提供86.00。我们现在被迫宣布，为了弥补开支，我们将对公共厕所收取如下费用：-’）
‘由于工部局财务状况不佳，合同价格已提高。铜元价值的突然下跌给纸张销售商造成了巨大损失。工部局充分意识到这一事实，最近考虑于3月1日从各个公共厕所移除告示：‘此为男用公共厕所。入场不收费。然而，每张粗纸收取一个铜元，尽管购买并非强制。’
1.

page_data.en:
Believing this to be true, we entered into a contract for
the sale of coarse paper. Many months have passed, but, to our
great surprise, the advanced measure is not yet borne out.
Since the Council has only levied tenders for the
control of such articles as the sale of coarse paper, it is
impossible for us to carry on our business. It is only by the grace of God that we are still alive.
We are unable to pay our taxes and duties from our
meagre earnings. It is necessary for the Council to take
action. We have received no reply to our letters.
Now, it is provided that the price of coarse paper
shall be fixed by the Council. If there is any change in the
market price, the Council will retain the
contract price. Formerly when it was provided that
coarse paper was sold at one copper a sheet, the copper was
still worth a life of bliss. Now the price has been
changed, how can we poor people bear such losses?
As the price of things and the sums required for contracts
have both gradually increased, we are finding it difficult to
carry on; the hardships we suffer are not to be found in any
other business. Moreover, the Public Health Department has been
constantly making trouble with us, forbidding us to sell coarse
paper and fining us on the slightest pretext. We do not know
indeed why the Council accepted contract money from us. We pay
monthly sums to the Council; if we are not to make any profit
from the sale of coarse paper, what are we spending our money
and energy for? The Council has regarded with equanimity its
own contradictory measures and has oppressed us to the best
of its ability. As our livelihood is endangered we have to beg

2.
page_data.zh:
深信此事属实，我们签订了一份粗纸销售合同。数月已过，但令我们大为惊讶的是，先前采取的措施并未得到证实。由于工部局仅就粗纸销售等此类物品的管控进行招标，我们无法继续经营。全赖上天庇佑，我们才得以存活。
微薄的收入使我们无力缴纳税款和捐税。工部局必须采取行动。我们的信件未获回复。
现规定粗纸价格由工部局固定。若市场价格有任何变动，工部局仍将维持合同价格。从前规定粗纸以每张铜元一枚出售时，这枚铜元尚足以维持安乐生活。如今价格已变，我们这些穷人如何承受如此损失？
由于物价和合同所需金额均逐渐增加，我们发现难以维持；我们所受的苦难是其他行业所没有的。此外，公共卫生处不断与我们为难，禁止我们销售粗纸，并借故罚款。我们实在不知工部局为何接受我们的合同款项。我们每月向工部局缴纳款项；如果我们从粗纸销售中无利可图，我们花费金钱和精力又是为了什么？工部局对其自相矛盾的措施安之若素，并极力压迫我们。由于生计受到威胁，我们不得不恳请

2.

page_data.en:
(Note: Received for translation, noon 15th May, 197.)

your Federation to sympathize with us and to uphold justice
by urging the Council to improve its method. Our requests
are as follows :-

1. To withdraw the notice saying that no payment is required.
2. To revise the rates for course of use.
3. To reduce the monthly rent.
4. To have the building repaired and painted, the roof fixed, the
drains unblocked and the sanitary conditions improved.

In view of the above requests which are based on facts, the Council is
requested to give them due consideration soon.

(Chop) On behalf of the undersigned
First Special District Citizens' Federation

(Note: Received for translation, noon 15th May, 197.)

In connection with the alleged intimidation of

and Liaoyang Road Market on May 20 (Vide Special Branch
Report of 21/5/37), the S.M.C. contractor instructed one of
his agents and three collectors to proceed to the Wayside
Market Lavatory at 1.30 p.m. May 21 in anticipation of further
acts of intimidation. Upon arrival, they saw six persons
including three sub-contractors named Tsang Foh-liu (張福),
Yeu Doong-kyi (俞同記) and Tsang Ah-kung (張阿根) at
the entrance to the lavatory. Tsang Foh-liu immediately
caught hold of the arm of the agent of the contractor named
Cheng Ah-doo (鄭阿大) while Tsang Ah-kung caught hold of
the arm of one of the collectors named Kyung Zang-sung
(慶長生). Tsang Ah-kung then produced a document and told
Kyung Zang-sung to sign it, stating that if he joined the
"union", he would receive assistance and that he should hand
over the contract fees he had collected on behalf of the
contractor to the "union". At the same time Tsang Foh-liu
produced a visiting card bearing the name of Mr. Chen Kiu-
feng (陳九峰) and in endorsing the view expressed by Tsang
Ah-kung remarked that the movement was being supported by
Mr. Chen Kiu-feng, an influential person, adding that it
was on Mr. Chen Kiu-feng's instructions that the money was
to be handed to the "union". Kyung Zang-sung refused to
sign the document whereupon Tsang Foh-liu told the contractor's

关于5月20日在路边市场和辽阳路市场公共厕所发生的所谓恐吓厕纸销售人员事件（参见1937年5月21日特别分部报告），工部局承包商指示其一名代理人和三名收款员于5月21日下午1点30分前往路边市场厕所，以防进一步的恐吓行为。到达后，他们看到包括三名分包商 Tsang Foh-liu (張福)、Yeu Doong-kyi (俞同記) 和 Tsang Ah-kung (張阿根) 在内的六人在厕所入口处。Tsang Foh-liu 立即抓住承包商代理人 Cheng Ah-doo (鄭阿大) 的手臂，而 Tsang Ah-kung 则抓住了一名名为 Kyung Zang-sung (慶長生) 的收款员的手臂。随后，Tsang Ah-kung 拿出一份文件，要求 Kyung Zang-sung 签字，声称如果他加入“工会”，他将获得援助，并应将他代表承包商收取的合同费移交给“工会”。与此同时，Tsang Foh-liu 出示了一张印有 Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峰) 先生名字的名片，并在附议 Tsang Ah-kung 的观点时 remarked 说，该运动正得到一位有影响力的人物 Chen Kiu-feng 先生的支持，并补充说，根据 Chen Kiu-feng 先生的指示，钱款要移交给“工会”。Kyung Zang-sung 拒绝在该文件上签字，于是 Tsang Foh-liu 告诉承包商代理人，将于5月28日向承包商发出通知，告知他根据 Chen Kiu-feng 先生的命令，所有合同费将在5月28日移交给“工会”而非承包商。该

承包商代理人称，在路边市场厕所外发生争执时，被带到警署的两名男子或任何散去的其他人均未使用威胁性语言。

然而，在5月21日被捕的两人中，路边市场厕所的分包商认出其中一名名为 Tsang Foh-liu 的人就是曾威胁说如果他不加入“工会”，只要他留在上海，其他分包商就会“拿着斧头找他”的人之一。此事发生于5月20日下午3点30分，地点在 Ward Road (华德路) 靠近 Paoting Road (保定路) 处。

鉴于这些威胁以及 Tsang Foh-liu 于5月20日对路边市场厕所的造访，他被控恐吓。与他一同被捕的另一名名为 Yeu Doong-kyi 的人被控协助和教唆 Tsang Foh-liu。

During enquiries made on the afternoon of May 21,

the 39th Branch of the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation. (Mr. Chen Kiu-feng is a committee member of
the Federation). A translation of the letter is as follows:
"According to a report from a member, Chang Foh-
Liu, sub-contractor for the sale of toilet paper at the
public lavatory on Chusan Road, was arrested by your station
at 3 p.m. to-day. As this arrest was unreasonable and
deprived him of his freedom and legal rights, we request you
to uphold justice. If Chang Foh-liu did act criminally,

39th Branch of the 1st Special

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of.. Tsang Foh-liu (曾福流)
native of. Kaoyu taken by me D.S. McKeown
at Wayside on the 21.5.37 and interpreted by...

My name is Tsang Foh-liu. I am a native of
Kaoyu (高邮), age 46, and reside at 223 Chusan Road. I
am a sub-contractor for the sale of toilet paper at the
public lavatory at Baikal Road near Dalny Road and at
Kwerming Road near Paoting Road.

At 11 a.m. on or about May 17, all sub-contractors
for the sale of toilet paper at public lavatories in the
Settlement assembled in the home of Mr. Chen Kiu-feng
(陈九峰), 8 Van Ziang Li, Elgin Road. When they requested
Mr. Chen Kiu-feng to negotiate with the S.M.C. for the
removal of the S.M.C. Board at the entrance of the public
lavatories fixing the price of toilet paper at 1 copper
per sheet, etc., Mr. Chen promised to give full support
and on this date he distributed some twenty of his name
cards among us and stated that should the S.M.P. interfere
with our movement, we should produce these cards.

At 11 a.m. May 19, some fifty sub-contractors
interviewed Mr. Chen Kiu-feng at his residence when Mr.
Chen instructed the attendance to have the contract fees
ready but to withhold the payment to the contractor and
deposit the same in the Shanghai Commercial and Savings
Bank, pending his negotiations.

Tsang Foh-liu.

我叫 Tsang Foh-liu。我是高邮 (Kaoyu) 人，现年46岁，居住在中山路223号。我是 Baikal Road (贝加尔路) 靠近 Dalny Road (大连路) 以及 Kwerming Road (光明路) 靠近 Paoting Road (保定路) 的公共厕所厕纸销售分包商。

大约在5月17日上午11点，租界内所有公共厕所厕纸销售分包商聚集在 Elgin Road (爱文义路) Van Ziang Li (范祥里) 8号 Chen Kiu-feng (陈九峰) 先生家中。当他们请求 Chen Kiu-feng 先生与工部局协商，移除公共厕所入口处将厕纸价格固定为每张1铜元等的工部局告示牌时，Chen 先生承诺给予全力支持，并于当天向我们分发了约二十张他的名片，声称如果工部局警务处干涉我们的运动，我们就出示这些名片。

5月19日上午11点，约五十名分包商在 Chen Kiu-feng 先生寓所会见了他，当时 Chen 先生指示在场人员准备好合同费，但暂停向承包商支付，而是将其存入上海商业储蓄银行，等待他的谈判结果。

Tsang Foh-liu.

Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by [Signature] 21/5/37

Chiang Ah Do (姜阿大), a representative of the Toilet
Paper Contractor of the Public Lavatories in the Settlement
submitted a report to the Special Branch this morning, May 21,
to the effect that three Chinese named Chang Foh Lu (张福度),
Chang Ah Kung (张阿公), two being sub-contractors, and one
named Mao Zueh Mi (毛雪米), an outsider, believed to be an agent
of the contractor for last year, called on the toilet paper sellers
at the lavatories located in Wayside Market and at the Liaoyang
Road Market at 3 p.m. May 20 /and demanded that they should sign a document which
the callers produced. The callers also instructed the sellers
not to pay any money to the contractor and threatened to assault
them should they refuse to comply with this instruction. The
sellers at the two lavatories refused to sign the document when
the callers intimated that they would come again in the afternoon
of May 21, 1937.

Mr. Pan Yung-tsing (潘永清), Contractor for the

refuse to pay the contract fee in order to enforce demands
for the removal of S.M.C. notices from public lavatories etc.

certain sub-contractors had recently started agitation and

Chi Yue-ming (季有明), toilet paper seller at
the Elgin Road lavatory.
Oong Chia-hai (翁家海), toilet paper seller at
the lavatory outside the Bund Garden.
Mr. Pan Yung-tsing stated that he was unable to
explain the motives of the agitation, but suspects that
some of his predecessors, contractors for past years may be
behind the movement, and that the object of the agitation is
to increase the price of toilet paper or as alternative,
induce him to break his contract.
Mr. Pan Yung-tsing also stated that in furthering
the agitation, Wong Wen-long had arranged through his
nephew named Chan Teh-yung (陳德雲), a P.W.D. road
construction coolie, and one named Kwan Boo-yuin (關步瀛),
P.W.D. coolie No.195, to secure assistance from Mr. Chen
Kiu-feng (陳九峰), committee member of the 1st Special
District Citizens' Federation.
The contractor has decided to ask payment of the
contract fees from the Sub-contractors on June 1, 1937.
According to information received by the contractor, although
no definite evidence is available, the sub-contractors will
refuse payment on June 1, 1937, and the contractor has decided
to ask for the return of the P.W.D. badges issued to the
authorised toilet paper sellers. There remains the
possibility that the sub-contractors will refuse to produce
the badges whereupon quarrels between the sub-contractors and
the agents of the contractor are liable to arise. Consequently
the contractor asks for police protection.
Jhy Xiown.
D. S.
Supt. D.C. (Special Branch).

Public lavatories in the Settlement - Unrest among
sub-contractors.

（印：Unrest among / CENTRAL REGISTRY / No. A 9214 / Date 21/5/27）

Unrest at present exists among the sub-contractors
who hold the contract for selling toilet paper in the
S.M.C. public lavatories in the Settlement. The sub-
contractors are agitating for the following four demands:-
1) That the board erected by the S.M.C. at the entrance
of a public lavatory, containing the following
inscription: "This is a men's lavatory. No admission
fee is charged. The price of toilet paper is one
copper per sheet, but it is not compulsory for anyone
to purchase same" be removed.
2) That the price of toilet paper be increased.
3) That the contract fee be reduced.
4) That should the foregoing demands be rejected, the
S.M.C. should abolish the contract system and directly
control the sale of toilet paper through the medium
of special supervisors.

Mr. Pan Yung-tsing (潘永清), Contractor for the
sale of toilet paper at public lavatories in the
Settlement, accompanied by one named Mr. Chiang (姜)
called at Police Headquarters in the forenoon of May 19
in connection with the report alleging that from June 1,
the sub-contractors would refuse to pay the contract
fee in order to enforce demands for the removal of
S.M.C. notices from public lavatories, etc. (vide Special
Branch Report dated 18/5/27).

In explaining their case, the callers stated that
certain sub-contractors had recently started agitating

租界内公共厕所 - 分包商中的动荡局势。

（印：动荡局势 / 中央登记处 / 编号 A 9214 / 日期 27/5/21）

目前，租界内持有工部局公共厕所手纸销售合同的分包商中存在动荡局势。分包商正在为以下四项要求进行煽动：
1) 撤除工部局在公共厕所入口处设立的告示牌，该告示牌内容如下：“此为男厕。不收入场费。手纸价格为每张铜元一枚，但任何人无强制购买义务”。
2) 提高手纸价格。
3) 降低合同费。
4) 如果上述要求被拒绝，工部局应废除合同制度，并通过专门监督员直接控制手纸销售。

租界内公共厕所手纸销售承包商潘永清（Pan Yung-tsing）先生，由一名姓姜（Chiang）的男子陪同，于5月19日上午前往警察总局，就一份报告所述事宜进行交涉，该报告称分包商将从6月1日起拒绝支付合同费，以强制要求撤除工部局在公共厕所等处张贴的告示等（参见5月18日的特科报告）。

Public lavatories in the Settlement - Unrest among
sub-contractors.

Unrest at present exists among the sub-contractors
who hold the contract for selling toilet paper in the
S.M.C. public lavatories in the Settlement. The sub-
contractors are agitating for the following four demands:-
1) That the board erected by the S.M.C. at the entrance
of a public lavatory, containing the following
inscription: "This is a men's lavatory. No admission
fee is charged. The price of toilet paper is one
copper per sheet, but it is not compulsory for anyone
to purchase same" be removed.
2) That the price of toilet paper be increased.
3) That the contract fee be reduced.
4) That should the foregoing demands be rejected, the
S.M.C. should abolish the contract system and directly
control the sale of toilet paper through the medium
of special supervisors.

Mr. Pan Yung-tsing (    ), Contractor for the
sale of toilet paper at public lavatories in the
Settlement, accompanied by one named Mr. Chiang (    )
called at Police Headquarters in the forenoon of May 19
in connection with the report alleging that from June 1,
the sub-contractors would refuse to pay the contract
fee in order to enforce demands for the removal of
S.M.C. notices from public lavatories, etc., (vide Special
Branch Report dated 18/5/37).

In explaining their case, the callers stated that
certain sub-contractors had recently started agitating
page_data.zh:
租界内的公共厕所——分包商中的动荡。

目前，持有在租界工部局公共厕所销售手纸合同的分包商中存在动荡。分包商正在鼓动以下四项要求：-
1) 拆除工部局竖立在公共厕所入口处的告示牌，该告示牌上写有以下文字：“此为男厕。不收入场费。手纸价格为每张铜元一枚，但任何人无强制购买义务”。
2) 提高手纸价格。
3) 降低合同费用。
4) 如果上述要求被拒绝，工部局应废除承包制度，并通过特别监督员直接控制手纸的销售。

潘永清（    ）先生，租界公共厕所手纸销售承包商，由一名姓蒋（    ）的先生陪同，于5月19日上午前往警察总局，就一份报告所称自6月1日起分包商将拒绝支付合同费以迫使工部局移除公共厕所告示等事宜进行交涉（参见1937年5月18日特科报告）。

在解释他们的情况时，来访者表示，某些分包商最近开始鼓动

for the removal of the S.M.C. boards stating that
the purchase of toilet paper was voluntary, from
the entrances of the lavatories. As far as the

named Wong Wen-leng (王文龍), sub-contractor at
the North Shanse Road lavatory near Haining Road, who
has allied with seven others who, though they are
sub-contractors themselves, have sub-let their

Mr. Pan Yung-tsing also stated that in furthering
the agitation, Wong Wen-long had arranged through
his nephew named Chen Teh-yung (      ), a P.W.D.
road construction coolie, and one named Kwan Bee-yuin
(      ), P.W.D. coolie No.195, to secure

The contractor has decided to ask payment of
the contract fees from the sub-contractors on June 1,
1937. According to information received by the
contractor, although no definite evidence is available,
the sub-contractors will refuse payment on June 1, 1937,
and the contractor has decided to ask for the return
of the P.W.D. badges issued to the authorised toilet
paper sellers. There remains the possibility that
the sub-contractors will refuse to produce the badges
whereupon quarrels between the sub-contractors and
the agents of the contractor are liable to arise.
Consequently the contractor asks for police protection.

总部
中央登记处
档案号 A 9219 /
15 / 5 / 37
日期 1937年5月15日。

主题 租界内公共厕所 - 分包商中的不安情绪。

制作人 D.S. McKeown 转呈人 [签名]

目前，持有在租界工部局公共厕所销售手纸合同的分包商中存在不安情绪。这些分包商正在鼓动提出以下四项要求：-
1) 撤除工部局竖立在公共厕所入口处的一块告示牌，该告示牌上写有以下文字：“这是男厕。不收入场费。手纸价格为每张铜元一枚，但任何人非必须购买。”
2) 提高手纸价格。
3) 降低承包费。
4) 如果上述要求被拒绝，工部局应废除承包制度，并通过专门监督员直接控制手纸的销售。

在租界内，共有85个男用公共厕所，1937年这些厕所的手纸销售权由工部局独家以合同形式授予位于星加坡路383号568弄的东方兴记公司（Tung Fang Shing Kee Company），以潘永清（Pan Yung-tsing）的名义，每月金额为3,853.00美元。东方兴记公司又将合同转包给64名分包商，承包费根据厕所所在地点的不同，每月从1美元到140美元不等。

To P. W. D.

Contract for the sale of Toilet Paper - 1937.

Owing to our failure, after repeated attempts, to
obtain your consent to either remove the "No Charge" plates
or reduce the contract price which request we submitted to
you at the request of all the sub-contractors, who are exceedingly
dissatisfied with us. Although there is no definite evidence
up to the present, yet there is persistent ru□ □hat, as
from June 1, they will unite themselves to refuse payment of
the contract price to the undersigned and will enforce the
sale of toilet paper on all visitors. In the interests of
public safety and also to protect ourselves from unforeseen
mishap, it is requested that you will kindly notify the Police
of this matter so that the necessary preparations may be taken
to forestall possible disorder.

手纸销售合同 - 1937年。

TOILET PAPER SELLERS ASSEMBLE
OUTSIDE THE ADMINISTRATION BUILDING.

Sir,

Some twenty or more sub-contractors holding contracts for the sale of toilet paper in the S.M.C. Public Lavatories assembled in the vicinity of the Administration Building (Hankow Road) at 11.45a.m. December 12 for the purpose of presenting a written petition to the Commissioner of Public Works concerning the proposed high prices demanded by the head contractor and other matters relating to the submission of tenders for the business.

The presence of the men was brought to the notice of the Police by Mr.H.Rose, Cleaning Department, who fearing that they might demonstrate when officials of the Council left for tiffin at noon; requested that a party of Police be on hand to cope with any possible occurrence that might arise.

A party of Police under Inspector Collison attended and found the men scattered in small groups at various points on Hankow and Kiangse Roads.

They were quite orderly and had no intention whatsoever of demonstrating or creating a disturbance.

Commissioner of Public Works Department.
Sir,
On the 4th inst. we were instructed to submit tenders regarding
various lavatories in which we are working under the contract with
your department, and at the opening of the tenders on the 5th inst.
the highest tender was $15,120.00. In view of the high cost of
rice as well as the coarse paper, it is difficult for us to maintain
our livelihood should we comply with the high tender as numerated
above. However we beg that the lavatories will be hired to us
under contract according to the tender regulations previously
pronounced by means of paying the guarantee money.
We were instructed that a reply would be given on the 8th inst.
and on the latter mentioned date we were again informed that we
hear from you on Monday. On Monday we failed to receive any
information as the Authorities had not reached a decision on the
matter. At the same time a number of contractors have despatched
representatives to negotiate with the former contractors at
various lavatories (all these representatives are majority of the
employees of the Tung Fong Company) for the purpose of increasing
the tender ranging from 100% to 70 or 80% according to the old rate.
If we refuse to accept the newly established tender price they
will re-contract with others. During the past ten years we have
never seen such a contractor who is not an experienced man and does
not consider the straitened circumstance regarding our livelihood.
We hereby submit this petition with the request that you will
make an announcement to authorize some experienced men and/ or
the tenders whose tender rate is similar to us to continue the
contract, thus saving several hundred lives.
From Chinese Paper Sellers,
of Public Lavatory of
S.H.C.

工务局总监。
先生，
本月4日，我方奉命就贵局合约项下正在运营的各处公厕提交投标书，而在本月5日的开标中，最高投标价为15,120.00美元。鉴于大米及草纸价格高昂，若按上述高额投标价执行，我方难以维持生计。然而，恳请依据此前公布的投标规定，通过缴纳保证金的方式，将公厕承包权授予我方。
我方获悉将于本月8日得到答复，而在该日又被告知将于周一收到贵方消息。周一我方未收到任何信息，因当局尚未就此事项作出决定。与此同时，多名承包商派遣代表与各公厕的前任承包商进行谈判（这些代表多为同兴公司雇员），目的是在旧费率基础上将投标价提高70%至80%，甚至100%。若我们拒绝接受新制定的投标价格，他们将与他人重新签约。过去十年间，我们从未见过如此不顾及从业者生计困境、缺乏经验的承包商。特此呈递请愿书，请求阁下发布公告，授权某些有经验的人士和/或投标费率与我方相似的投标人继续履行合约，从而挽救数百人的生计。

June 15, 1937.

Public Lavatories in the Settlement - Sub-contractor
warned.

During the morning of June 15, Chang Foh Liu (
former sub-contractor for the sale of toilet paper at Baikal
and Kwenming Road lavatories was called to the office of the
Special Branch and warned against intimidating the employees
of the contractor who will take over the sale of toilet paper
at the above lavatories with effect from the afternoon of
June 15. Chang Foh Liu stated that he had no intention of
intimidating these employees but considers that he has been
defrauded by the contractor. He was advised to take civil
action if he thought this necessary but warned that no further
unlawful activities would be tolerated.

1937年6月15日。

租界内公共厕所 - 分包商受到警告。

6月15日上午，张福流 (Chang Foh Liu)（前贝加尔路和克明路公厕厕纸销售分包商）被召至特别处办公室，并被警告不得恐吓将于6月15日下午起接管上述公厕厕纸销售的承包商员工。张福流表示他无意恐吓这些员工，但认为自已受到了承包商的欺诈。建议他如有必要可采取民事诉讼，但警告称绝不容忍进一步的非法活动。

特别支部（Special Branch）警探 McKeown 从被告处取得的供词中，被告否认参与任何恐吓行为，然而在第一被告（Tseng Poh Liu，音译）和第三被告（Tseng Ah Kung，音译）被捕时，两人都持有一张相同的名片，属于华人纳税会（Chinese Ratepayers Association）执行委员会、上海市一区市民会（1st Special District Citizen's Federation）成员陈九峰先生（陳九峰）。据被告称，陈九峰曾承诺就移除公共厕所挡板一事向工部局（S.M.C.）请愿（这些挡板涉及手纸销售，购买手纸并非强制性的）。

这些名片是在五月初（确切日期不详）于爱文义路（Elgin Road）万祥里8号陈九峰先生（陳九峰）家中举行的一次由分包商参加的会议上分发的，三名被告均出席了该会议，会上讨论了移除这些挡板的事宜。

控告人和证人明确指认第一被告（Tseng Poh Liu，音译）和第三被告（Tseng Ah Kung，音译）曾于1937年5月21日造访中山路市场的公共厕所，当时他们试图诱使控告人（Kyung Sang Sung，音译）签署一份文件，第二被告（Yeu Doeng Kyi，音译）当时也在场。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

The two accused were arraigned at the S.S.D. Court on 22-5-37, the case being remanded until 29-5-37.

At the conclusion of the hearing in the Shanghai Special District Court, at 11.30 a.m. 22-5-37, C.D.S.91 effected the arrest of one Tsung Ah Kung, (3rd accused) on the stairway of the court premises, who was pointed out to him by the complainant Tsing Sang Sung (岑長生) as being one of the men who had participated together with the 1st accused (Tseng Poh Liu) in the acts of intimidation committed on the 20-5-37 and 21-5-37, he already having implicated this man in his evidence given to the S.S.D. Court as being one of the men concerned in the act of intimidation.

3rd accused Tsung Ah Kung (張阿根) aged 45, nativ of Kompo, sub-contractor, living 1 Urge Road.

This accused who is also a sub-contractor for the selling of toilet paper in Public Lavatories at Quinsan Park, Cheoufoong and Huohow Roads, denies participation in these acts of intimidation, however he is definitely implicated by the complainant as being one of the men concerned.

Charged, intimidation, Contrary to Art.304 Section I of C.C.R.C.

May 17, 1937.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

PUBLIC LAVATORY CONTRACTORS REQUEST S.M.C. TO WITHDRAW
FREE ACCESS TO LAVATORIES

Toilet paper is offered for sale at one copper
per sheet at the entrance of the various public lavatories
in the International Settlement. Last year the S.M.C.
accepted the tender of $3,853 of the Tung Faung Shing Kee
Company (東方兴记公司) for the sale of toilet paper.
Before opening the tender, the Council promised to withdraw,
as from March 1, the notice posted at the entrance to every
public lavatory which bears the inscription: "Admission
is free. Toilet paper is sold at one copper per sheet,
but the purchase of toilet paper is not compulsory." The
Council, however, has not kept its word after accepting
the tender of the Tung Faung Shing Kee Company.
Sustaining great losses owing to the rise in
the price of toilet paper, various contractors recently
made a joint appeal to the S.M.C. and submitted the following
three demands:-
1) That the notice of "Free Admission" be withdrawn.
2) That the selling price of toilet paper be re-adjusted.
3) That the price of the tender be reduced.
If the above three demands cannot be accepted,
the S.M.C. is requested to cancel invitation of tenders
and instead engage men to take over the work.
The S.M.C. has not yet given a reply.

During a general meeting held by the Shanghai
First Special District Citizens' Federation on May 15, the
various contractors appealed to the Federation. In reply,
the Executive Committee of the Federation said that in its
opinion the selling price of toilet paper at one copper
per sheet was not too low and that an investigation was
deemed necessary as to whether an increase in the selling
price of the toilet paper would affect the poor people,
and that if the contractors were found to be losing enough
to warrant an increase, the Federation would open negotiations
with the S.M.C. over the matter.

公共厕所承包商请求工部局撤销
免费入厕告示

国际租界各公共厕所入口处均以每张铜元一枚的价格出售厕纸。去年，工部局接受了東方兴记公司（Tung Faung Shing Kee Company）3,853美元的投标，由其负责销售厕纸。在开标之前，理事会承诺自3月1日起，撤除张贴在每个公共厕所入口处的告示，该告示上写着：“免费入内。厕纸每张售价铜元一枚，但购买厕纸并非强制。”然而，工部局在接受東方兴记公司的投标后并未信守承诺。
由于厕纸价格上涨造成巨大损失，各位承包商最近联合向工部局提出上诉，并提交以下三项要求：-
1) 撤除“免费入内”的告示。
2) 重新调整厕纸售价。
3) 降低投标价格。
如果上述三项要求不能被接受，请求工部局取消招标，转而雇佣人员接管此项工作。
工部局尚未给予答复。

在5月15日举行的上海第一特区市民联合会全体会议上，各位承包商向联合会提出申诉。作为回应，联合会执行委员会表示，他们认为每张铜元一枚的厕纸售价并不算太低，有必要调查提高厕纸售价是否会影响穷人，如果发现承包商的亏损足以证明需要提价，联合会将就此事项与工部局展开谈判。

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :- 18-5-37

PUBLIC LAVATORY CONTRACTORS APPEAL FOR RELIEF

The Shanghai First Special District Citizens'
Federation is in receipt of a joint report from the
contractors of various public lavatories in the Inter-
national Settlement, a summarized translation of which is
as follows :-
    "We depend on the selling of toilet paper
at the various public lavatories for our living. In
the very beginning when the price of all commodities was
normal, we were able to support our families, but it is
different nowadays because of the high cost of living.
    "The S.M.C. regarded the business of selling
of toilet paper and of attending to the lavatories as very
profitable and even giving a chance of making a fortune.
At first the Council secretly demanded money from the
toilet paper sellers but now it has been openly inviting
tenders. Last year the Council accepted a tender of $3,853
from Chang Dong-shing (張桐兴 the Tung Faung Shing Kee
Company 東方興記公司), who had assured various toilet
paper sellers that the Council was aware of their hardships
and would remove, commencing on March 1, from public
lavatories, notice stating that the admission was free
and that the purchase of toilet paper was not compulsory.
Believing this, we took over the contract, but so far the
notices have not been withdrawn. Since the Council openly
invites tenders for the sale of toilet paper at public
lavatories, naturally the sale of toilet paper is a
legitimate business and should receive protection from
the Council. Then how can the Council allow free
admission to the lavatories? If the Council establishes
the lavatories for the convenience of the public, it should
not invite tenders. How can we get back remuneration for
the money we have paid?
    "Moreover, the Public Health Department of
the S.M.C, is constantly harsh towards us by prohibiting
sales and forcefully imposes fines on us. We cannot
understand why the Council invites tenders.. If we do
not make a profit on our outlay, why do we waste our energy
and money? We, therefore, request your honourable
Federation to uphold justice and to urge the Council to
introduce the following improvements :-
    "(1) That the notice of "Free Admission"
be withdrawn.
    "(2) That the selling price of toilet paper
be re-adjusted.
    "(3) That the price of the tender be reduced.
    "(4) That if the above three demands cannot
be accepted, the Council should cancel invitation of
tenders and instead engage men to take over the work."

公共厕所承包商请求救济

上海第一特区市民联合会收到国际租界各公共厕所承包商的联合报告，摘要译文如下：-
    “我们依靠在各公共厕所销售厕纸维持生计。起初，当所有商品价格正常时，我们能够养家糊口，但现在情况不同了，因为生活成本高昂。
    “工部局认为销售厕纸和管理厕所的业务非常有利可图，甚至有机会发大财。起初，理事会暗中向厕纸销售者索要钱财，但现在已公开招标。去年，理事会接受了张桐兴（Chang Dong-shing，東方興記公司 Tung Faung Shing Kee Company）3,853美元的投标，他曾向各位厕纸销售者保证，理事会知晓他们的困难，并将从3月1日起从公共厕所撤除声明‘免费入内且购买厕纸非强制’的告示。基于此信念，我们承接了合同，但至今告示仍未撤除。既然理事会公开招标在公共厕所销售厕纸，那么厕纸销售自然是一项合法业务，应受到理事会的保护。那么，理事会怎能允许免费进入厕所呢？如果理事会设立厕所以便公众使用，就不应招标。我们如何收回已支付的款项作为报酬？
    “此外，工部局公共卫生处对我们态度严厉，禁止销售并强行对我们处以罚款。我们无法理解理事会为何招标..如果我们无法从支出中获利，为何要浪费我们的精力和金钱？因此，我们请求贵联合会主持公道，敦促理事会实施以下改进措施：-
    “(1) 撤除‘免费入内’的告示。
    “(2) 重新调整厕纸售价。
    “(3) 降低投标价格。
    “(4) 如果上述三项要求不能被接受，理事会应取消招标，转而雇佣人员接管此项工作。”

letter and ask you to give me a reply within the period 
sp cified. "

PUBLIC LAVATORY CONTRACTORS R= iUEST SeMeC. TO WITHDRAW 
F CCESS TO LAVATOR 


Toilet paper is offered for sale at one copper 
per sheet at the entrance of the various public lavatories 
in the International Settlement. Last year the S.M.C. 
accepted the tender of  »3,853 of the Tung Faung Shing Kee 
Company ( % 7 %764%¢]) for the sale of toilet paper. 
Before opening the tender, the Council promised to withdraw, 
as from March 1, the notice posted at the entrance to every 
public lavatory which bears the inscriptions "admission 
is free. Toilet paper is sold at one copper per sheet, 
but the purchase of toilet paper is not compulsory." The 
Council, however, has not kept its word after accepting 
the tender of the Tung Faung Shing Kee Company. 

Sustaining great losses owing to the rise in 
the price of toilet paper, various contractors recently 
made a joint appeal to the S.-C. and submitted the following 
three demandss- 

i) That the notice of “Free @dmission“” be withdrawn. 
2) That the selling price of toilet paper be re-adjusted. 
3) That the price of the tender be reduced. 

If the above three demands cannot be accepted, 
the SeM.C. is requested to cancel invitation of tenders 
and instead engage men to take over the worke 

: The SeMeCe has not yet given a reply. 


! 


During a general meeting held by the Shanghai 
First Syecial District Citizens Federation on May 15, the 
various contractors appealed to the Federation. In reply, 
the Executive Committee of the Federation said that in its 
Opinion the selling price of toilet paper at one copper 
per sheet was not too low and that an investigation was 
deemed necessary as to whether an inorease in the selling 
price of the toilet paper would affect the poor people, 
and that if the contractors were found to be losing enough 
to warrant an increase, the Federation would open negotiations. 
with the 3.M-C. over the matter.
